db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                SELECT trade_date::text AS d, symbol, t1_return
                FROM returns
                WHERE trade_date >= CAST(:min_d AS date)
                  AND trade_date <= CAST(:max_d AS date)
                  AND t1_return IS NOT NULL
                """
                ),
                {"min_d": min_d, "max_d": max_d},
            ).mappings
